class.name: UltralightView
class.brief_description: Render HTML, CSS and JavaScript in a Godot TextureRect.
class.description: Render HTML, CSS and JavaScript in a Godot TextureRect. Initializes automatically after entering the tree with a nonzero size. Use load_url or load_html for runtime navigation, and UltralightAPI to install application bindings before page scripts and restore them after navigation. New evaluations use shared containers and explicit UltralightResult errors. Navigation, rebuild and close invalidate document handles and pending tasks. Logic and rendering run on the Godot frame loop; AppCore is not required.

method.name: set_accelerated
method.description: Set [member accelerated].

method.name: get_accelerated
method.description: Return [member accelerated].

method.name: is_accelerated
method.description: Return whether this view actually uses GPU RenderingDevice. A request through [member accelerated] can fall back to CPU if the device is unavailable or initialization fails.

method.name: get_render_statistics
method.description:
Return rendering statistics. These fields are always present: - [code]accelerated[/code]: actual rendering backend. - [code]sdk_edition[/code], [code]sdk_max_fps[/code]: SDK edition and its frame-rate ceiling; zero means no edition ceiling. - [code]max_render_fps[/code]: requested per-view frame-rate limit. - [code]ultralight_render_us[/code]: Ultralight rendering time in microseconds, shared across all views. - [code]cpu_page_upload_bytes[/code], [code]cpu_mipmap_count[/code], [code]cpu_upload_us[/code]: CPU Surface upload counters for this view. These survive reinitialization.
Only an active accelerated view adds GPU fields: [code]gpu_available[/code], [code]bitmap_upload_bytes[/code], [code]geometry_upload_bytes[/code], [code]state_upload_bytes[/code], [code]draws[/code], [code]batches[/code], [code]feedback_copies[/code], [code]render_passes[/code], [code]rd_record_us[/code], [code]gpu_us[/code] and [code]gpu_draws_by_shader[/code]. GPU counters cover all views. Zero GPU timing can mean timestamps are unavailable. GPU mode can still upload SDK resource bitmaps, including Canvas content.
CPU, uninitialized and fallback views omit GPU fields. Rendering preparation timings exclude JavaScript execution outside the render call and do not represent total application frame time.

method.name: set_max_render_fps
method.description: Set [member max_render_fps].

method.name: get_max_render_fps
method.description: Return [member max_render_fps].

method.name: get_bridge_statistics
method.description: Return counts of active bindings, host container proxies, host object proxies and retained JavaScript handles for diagnostics.

method.name: unbind
method.description: Revoke the current temporary export with this name, including nested proxies.

method.name: load_url
method.description: Navigate to url and return a task that completes at main-document DOM readiness. timeout is in seconds, finite and greater than zero. Before layout, the request waits for a usable size.

method.name: load_html
method.description: Load inline HTML with base_url for relative resources. Return a task for main-document DOM readiness; timeout is in seconds.

method.name: reload
method.description: Reload the current page and return its DOM readiness task. An inline page retains its HTML and base URL.

method.name: wait_ready
method.description: Observe the current main document. May complete immediately when already ready. Navigation invalidates an unfinished wait.

method.name: wait_for_selector
method.description: Wait until a CSS selector matches an element in the current main document. Invalid selectors fail. This checks existence, not visibility.

method.name: evaluate
method.description: Evaluate source and return an explicit result. Arrays and objects are live shared handles; null is Nil and undefined is UltralightUndefined.

method.name: evaluate_copy
method.description: Evaluate source and recursively copy own enumerable data into independent Godot containers. Cycles, unsupported values and depth over 64 fail.

method.name: evaluate_handle
method.description: Evaluate source and retain its raw JavaScript value, including primitives, in an UltralightJSValue handle.

method.name: evaluate_async
method.description: Evaluate source and observe a returned Promise, or complete with an ordinary value. Timeout is in seconds. Navigation cancels delivery to the old document.

method.name: is_closed
method.description: Return whether close has permanently disabled this View.

method.name: close
method.description: Permanently close this View, detach API registries, invalidate document handles and finish pending tasks.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Return whether the native SDK View exists.

method.name: is_loading
method.description: Return whether the main document is loading.

method.name: is_document_ready
method.description: Return [member document_ready].

method.name: get_navigation_id
method.description: Return [member navigation_id].

method.name: get_current_url
method.description: Return [member current_url].

method.name: get_last_load_error
method.description: Return the latest structured main-document load error, or null when no error is recorded.

method.name: input_text
method.description: Send committed text to the focused page. This does not provide IME preedit or candidate-window positioning.

method.name: scroll_pixels
method.description: Send a pixel scroll delta to the page.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Recreate the native View to apply backend configuration. Invalidates old document state and tasks; attached API registries are restored for the new document.

method.name: init_view
method.description: Compatibility alias for rebuilding. Automatic initialization and explicit load methods handle ordinary layout and loading.

method.name: bind_func
method.description: Compatibility function export. New code should use bind_function or UltralightAPI.register_function.

method.name: bind_object
method.description: Export a temporary Godot Object with optional UltralightBindingOptions. Return its revocable binding. Use UltralightAPI.register_object for persistent exports or root Array and Dictionary containers.

method.name: bind_function
method.description: Export a temporary global function and return its revocable UltralightBinding. For navigation persistence use UltralightAPI.

method.name: bind_object_legacy
method.description: Compatibility entry for the old query_members boolean. New code should use UltralightAPI and UltralightBindingOptions.

method.name: execute_script
method.description: Compatibility evaluation using copied values and Nil/logged errors. Prefer evaluate for explicit errors and shared values.

method.name: fire_key_event
method.description: Forward a keyboard event to an initialized page. Normal Control input forwards key events while the web view has focus.

method.name: fire_mouse_event
method.description: Forward a mouse event to an initialized page. [param position] uses coordinates local to the web view, in pixels. Pass [code]MOUSE_BUTTON_NONE[/code] for motion, a mouse button with [param is_pressed] for press/release, or a wheel button for scrolling. The Control normally forwards its own GUI input automatically.

method.name: on_update_frame
method.description: Internal lifecycle callback. Publishes the rendered texture after Godot drawing. It is connected automatically; applications should not invoke it.

method.name: on_resized
method.description: Internal lifecycle callback. Resizes an initialized page to match the Control. It is connected automatically; applications should not invoke it.

members.member: Request GPU rendering through Godot RenderingDevice. Configure before initialization. Compatibility, headless and unavailable devices use CPU Surface rendering. Use [method is_accelerated] to check the actual backend. Reinitialization reloads the page.

Limit this view's animation and repaint rate. Changes apply immediately and survive [method init_view]. Zero removes the per-view limit; the SDK edition ceiling still applies (60 FPS for the public Free edition). Godot frame limits and VSync are independent.
Initial page source: 0 selects URL, 1 selects inline HTML.
URL loaded during initial automatic initialization when source_type is 0.
HTML loaded during initial automatic initialization when source_type is 1.
Base URL for relative resources in initial inline HTML.
Whether the current main document has reached DOM readiness. Read-only.
Current main-document URL, separate from initial source configuration. Read-only.
Legacy inline source setter. Prefer initial_html and source_type or runtime load_html.
Legacy URL source setter. Prefer initial_url or runtime load_url.
Enable a transparent page background. Configure before initialization. Changing it on an existing view requires reinitialization.
Defer automatic initialization. Explicit load requests initialize after layout even when lazy is enabled.

signal.name: window_ready
signal.description: Main-document global is available. API registries are installed, and page scripts have not yet executed.

signal.name: dom_ready
signal.description: Main-document DOM is ready. State is updated before dispatch. Does not imply application async work is finished.

signal.name: frame_dom_ready
signal.description: Any frame DOM is ready, including the main frame. Inspect event.is_main_frame and event.frame_id.

signal.name: load_finished
signal.description: Main-document loading finished. Does not guarantee permanent network inactivity.

signal.name: load_failed
signal.description: Main-document failure. failure contains event, error, domain and code.

signal.name: console_message
signal.description: Page console entry. Includes level, message, source_url, line, column and navigation_id when available.

signal.name: on_window_object_ready
signal.description: Compatibility signal. Prefer window_ready(event) and persistent UltralightAPI registrations.

signal.name: on_dom_ready
signal.description: Compatibility main-document DOM signal. Prefer dom_ready(event); iframe notifications use frame_dom_ready(event).
